narrative_summary: SPX closed 7,575.39, pushing to within a fraction of a point of the 6/15 swing high (7,578) on the strongest up-first Monte Carlo skew of the recovery (78% adjusted, clearing all regime thresholds) with a complacent sub-16 VIX and neutral sentiment. The structural bias remains Late Bull / Topping: the bull skeleton is intact and momentum is improving, but the market is grinding into hard resistance with a zero-cushion ERP (0.37%) at the valuation ceiling, McClellan breadth near its lows, and junk credit refusing to confirm. The justified posture is trim bias into strength at the swing high rather than chasing the breakout, given the collision between improving technicals/Monte Carlo and deteriorating internals/valuation.
